subject: prd/incident-machinery
statement: The incident-entry shape shall exist as a version-pinned template (`incident-entry-template/v1`) under the templates directory, from which the writer renders entries and against which `lint-incidents` checks — one schema definition, two consumers.
rationale: the vision's "each document kind with a template" reaches the incident class; writer/lint drift becomes structurally impossible
fit_criterion: the template file exists and is version-pinned; a writer-emitted entry and the template's example both pass lint; writer and lint consume one schema definition in code (inspection)
